title: Native spawn headroom
summary: Every native launch and wake checks at least 1 GiB available memory with a three-second spawn stagger. macOS probes only vm_stat and has no swap ceiling because swap grows on demand. Linux reads /proc/meminfo and also requires 512 MiB free swap when swap is enabled. Low or unreadable capacity refuses before spawning; the launch or wake record names the reason, observed bytes and recovery.
